body: When a send to a worker returns notificationDisposition durableButNotWoken (or heldBehindPausedQueue), immediately GET /api/sessions/{id}. If it reads queuePaused=true with pending prompts and the session is idle, POST /api/sessions/{id}/queue/resume, then read back; the turn may take a second to begin. Since 2026-10-16 queues have been seen paused at ORDINARY turn ends with no stop (Coder 7422 at 23:07Z on build 12e16176), so a worker can idle forever otherwise. Record each occurrence on w-80e0cb2002da.
